---
title: "Examples"
---

Six complete workflows, each ported from a canonical, citable R original and
worked **backward from a realistic end model**: the model's requirements
decide which of the [four stages](../user-guide/basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd)
the recipe needs. Every report executes at build time; each example also links
a line-matched [R ↔ Python side-by-side](sbs/sbs-index.html){target="_blank"}.

| Example | Model | Missing | Wrangle | Model prep | Multivar |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Ames mini](ames-mini-lm.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr01-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [TMwR ch. 8](https://www.tmwr.org/recipes)</small> | lm | none | log, dummy | none | none |
| [Ames realistic](ames-realistic-lm.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr03-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [TMwR ch. 8](https://www.tmwr.org/recipes)</small> | lm | none | log, other, dummy | interact, ns | none |
| [Ames xgboost](ames-xgboost.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr11-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [TMwR ch. 13](https://www.tmwr.org/grid-search)</small> | xgboost | none | novel\*, one-hot, zv† | none | none |
| [Concrete KNN](concrete-knn.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr14-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [TMwR ch. 15](https://www.tmwr.org/workflow-sets)</small> | KNN | none | none | normalize | none |
| [Beans PCA](beans-pca.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr16-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [TMwR ch. 16](https://www.tmwr.org/dimensionality)</small> | none | none | zv†, orderNorm | normalize | PCA |
| [Credit glmnet](credit-glmnet.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/kuhn-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"}<br/><small>from [recipes vignette](https://recipes.tidymodels.org/articles/recipes.html)</small> | glmnet | impute ×2 | other, dummy, zv† | normalize | none |

\* not yet built in mlfeatures; the report runs the buildable subset, and the
side-by-side marks the gap in red where it occurs.
† zero-variance filter; filters sit beside the stages rather than in them,
shown here where they run.

## Running the examples locally

The reports execute with the `examples` extra:

```bash
uv sync --extra examples
uv run quarto render examples   # or: great-docs build
```

Datasets ship with the package and load from `mlfeatures.data`
(`from mlfeatures.data import ames`). They were exported from R's
[modeldata](https://modeldata.tidymodels.org/) package (`ames`, `concrete`,
`credit_data`) and the dry-beans data from Koklu & Ozkan via the
[beans](https://cran.r-project.org/package=beans) package; see the
[`mlfeatures.data`](../reference/data.qmd) reference page for each dataset's
shape, target, and source.
